### Hurton et al, PLoS Biology 2025
###
### PCA for all 3 dev stages. Some code is very redundant with pca_dome_stage.R.txt
###
### Running everything will yield various data files and figures in the 'output'
### directory. Some of the files are just for reference, some feed into
### other analyses
###
### Nomenclature note: "enh.like.dist" = k4me1_enh, "prom.like.dist" = k4me2_enh,
### prom.like.prom = "highk4_prom", enh.like.prom = "lowk4_prom"
###
### File dependencies:
###     output/atac_open_coverage_reshaped.txt (generated by pca_dome_stage.R.txt)
###     output/atac_select_high_k4me1.bed (generated by pca_dome_stage.R.txt)
###     data/atac_open_coverage_1kshield.txt

## Set to TRUE to get some extra output files (~180 MB total)
WRITE_ALL_OUTPUT <- FALSE



library(viridis)

#############
# 1. Initial data prep
#############

## Dome stage previously reshaped data
data3 <- read.table('output/atac_open_coverage_reshaped.txt', header=T, sep='\t')

## 1K and shield atac-seq open region coverage
timedata <- read.table("data/atac_open_coverage_1kshield.txt", header=TRUE)

## Join first 8 columns to get inferred strand
timedata <- merge(data3[,1:8], timedata, by=1:7)


## Based on inferred strand from dome file, flip left and right
plus_regions <- timedata[timedata$inferred_strand == '+', ]
names(plus_regions) <- gsub("_left", "_up", names(plus_regions))
names(plus_regions) <- gsub("_right", "_down", names(plus_regions))

minus_regions <- timedata[timedata$inferred_strand == '-', ]
names(minus_regions) <- gsub("_left", "_down", names(minus_regions))
names(minus_regions) <- gsub("_right", "_up", names(minus_regions))
minus_regions <- minus_regions[,names(plus_regions)]

timedata <- rbind(plus_regions, minus_regions)
timedata0 <- timedata

## Normalize center coverage to 500bp (center = atac peak, so variable length)
center_data <- timedata[,grepl("_center", names(timedata))]
atac_open_lengths <- timedata$end - timedata$start
center_data <- round(500 * center_data / atac_open_lengths, 3)

up_data <- timedata[,grepl("_up", names(timedata))]
down_data <- timedata[,grepl("_down", names(timedata))]

timedata <- cbind(timedata[,1:7], timedata[,'inferred_strand', drop=F], center_data, up_data, down_data)

write.table(timedata, 'output/atac_open_coverage_1kshield_reshaped.txt', row.names=F, quote=F, sep='\t')


## Merge dome stage with the 1k and shield
data4 <- merge(data3, timedata, by=1:8)

## Normalize to log2 RPKM, smoothing factor 1
## Also rename samples to facilitate sorting (_1, _2, etc at the end)
SMOOTH=1

norm_factors <- read.table('data/sample_totals.txt', header=T)
names(data4) <- gsub('igg_dmso_', 'igg_d', names(data4))

## Adjust the names to match current analysis
#######norm_factors$Sample_Name <- tolower(norm_factors$Sample_Name)
norm_factors$Sample_Name <- gsub('1k', 'X1k', norm_factors$Sample_Name)
norm_factors$Sample_Name <- gsub('igg_dmso_', 'igg_d', norm_factors$Sample_Name)

## Get norm factors
norm_factors <- subset(norm_factors, Sample_Name %in% gsub("_center", "", names(data4)), select = c('Sample_Name', 'PCR_Dedup_1'))

markreps <- norm_factors$Sample_Name
unpooled <- data4[,'name', drop=F]
used_marks <- c() ## Running list of marks already seen

for (mark in markreps) {
	prefix <- gsub("_[0-9d]+$", "", mark, perl=T)
	used_marks <- c(used_marks, prefix)
	used_count <- sum(used_marks == prefix)
	
	data_subset <- data4[,grepl(mark, names(data4))]
	norm <- 2 * 1e6 / norm_factors[norm_factors$Sample_Name == mark,'PCR_Dedup_1']
		
	for (region in c('up', 'center', 'down')) {
		unpooled[,paste0(prefix, '_', region, '_', used_count)] <- log2(norm * data_subset[,grepl(region, names(data_subset))] + SMOOTH)
	}
}

## Reorder columns
mark_order <- c('name')
for (mark in unique(used_marks)) {
	mark_count <- sum(used_marks == mark)
	for (region in c('up', 'center', 'down')) {
		for (i in 1:mark_count) {
			mark_order <- c(mark_order, paste0(mark, '_', region, '_', i))		
		}
	}
}

unpooled <- unpooled[,mark_order]


#############
# 2. PCA on all marks all stages (Fig S3C)
#############

## Perform UNPOOLED PCA on entire timecourse -- do not include igg samples
unpooled0 <- unpooled
unpooled <- unpooled[,!grepl('igg', names(unpooled))]

input_matrix <- as.matrix(unpooled[,2:ncol(unpooled)])
row.names(input_matrix) <- unpooled$name

pca <- prcomp(input_matrix, center=T, scale.=T)

## Write out raw data files
if (WRITE_ALL_OUTPUT) {
	write.table(input_matrix, 'output/TIMECOURSE_pca_input_matrix.txt', sep='\t', quote=F)
	write.table(pca$x, 'output/TIMECOURSE_pca_rotated_data.txt', sep='\t', quote=F)
	write.table(pca$rot, 'output/TIMECOURSE_pca_loadings.txt', sep='\t', quote=F)
}

data_pca_rot <- cbind(data4[,1:8], pca$x)

## Plot rotated data labeled by dome-stage classifications
## of enhancers and promoters

focus_regions <- read.table('output/atac_select_high_k4me1.bed')
data_pca_rot_sub <- subset(data_pca_rot, rowSums(input_matrix[,2:ncol(input_matrix)]) > 0)

data_pca_rot_sub$bg <- '#88888822'
data_pca_rot_sub$bg[row.names(data_pca_rot_sub) %in% focus_regions[focus_regions[,5] == 'enh.like.dist',4]]="#0080FF22" #darkblue
data_pca_rot_sub$bg[row.names(data_pca_rot_sub) %in% focus_regions[focus_regions[,5] == 'prom.like.dist',4]]="#CC000044" #darkred
data_pca_rot_sub$bg[row.names(data_pca_rot_sub) %in% focus_regions[focus_regions[,5] == 'prom.like.prom',4]]="#FF800022" #orange
data_pca_rot_sub$bg[row.names(data_pca_rot_sub) %in% focus_regions[focus_regions[,5] == 'enh.like.prom',4]]="#2EE1CF44" #aquamarine

data_pca_rot_sub$color <- '#88888833'
data_pca_rot_sub$color[row.names(data_pca_rot_sub) %in% focus_regions[focus_regions[,5] == 'enh.like.dist',4]]="#0080FF33" #darkblue
data_pca_rot_sub$color[row.names(data_pca_rot_sub) %in% focus_regions[focus_regions[,5] == 'prom.like.dist',4]]="#CC000055" #darkred
data_pca_rot_sub$color[row.names(data_pca_rot_sub) %in% focus_regions[focus_regions[,5] == 'prom.like.prom',4]]="#FF800033" #orange
data_pca_rot_sub$color[row.names(data_pca_rot_sub) %in% focus_regions[focus_regions[,5] == 'enh.like.prom',4]]="#2EE1CF55" #aquamarine

data_pca_rot_sub$pch=20
data_pca_rot_sub$pch[row.names(data_pca_rot_sub) %in% focus_regions[focus_regions[,5] == 'enh.like.dist',4]]=16 
data_pca_rot_sub$pch[row.names(data_pca_rot_sub) %in% focus_regions[focus_regions[,5] == 'prom.like.dist',4]]=15 
data_pca_rot_sub$pch[row.names(data_pca_rot_sub) %in% focus_regions[focus_regions[,5] == 'prom.like.prom',4]]=18 
data_pca_rot_sub$pch[row.names(data_pca_rot_sub) %in% focus_regions[focus_regions[,5] == 'enh.like.prom',4]]=17 


pdf("output/TIMECOURSE_pca_biplot_1vs_2.pdf",10,5)

XLIMS=c(-12,55)
YLIMS=c(-11,11)

with(data_pca_rot_sub, plot(PC1, PC2, cex=1, main="PCA Timecourse Samples unpooled", xlab="PC1", ylab="PC2", col=bg, pch=pch, xlim=XLIMS, ylim=YLIMS))

dev.off()



#############
# 3. PCA on K4me marks over time (Fig S3D)
#############

## Set variables to be K4me1-3 up/center/down;
## set rows to be atac-seq regions at each timepoint as separate rows.
## Visualize movements of each region group over time

k4_samples <- unpooled[,grepl('k4me', names(unpooled))]
row.names(k4_samples) <- unpooled$name

## Undo log to facilitate pooling
k4_samples <- 2**k4_samples - SMOOTH

## Pool replicates
sample_names <- gsub('_[1234]$', '', names(k4_samples), perl=T)

k4_samples2 <- data.frame(row.names=row.names(k4_samples))
for (sample_name in unique(sample_names)) {
	k4_samples2[,sample_name] <- rowSums(k4_samples[,grepl(sample_name, names(k4_samples)), drop=F])
}

## Separate according to each stage
final_names <- c('me1u', 'me1c', 'me1d', 'me2u', 'me2c', 'me2d', 'me3u', 'me3c', 'me3d')
k4_samples3 <- data.frame()
for (time in c('X1k', 'dome', 'shield')) {
	block <- k4_samples2[,grepl(time, names(k4_samples2))]
	row.names(block) <- paste0(row.names(block), '_', time)
	names(block) <- final_names
	k4_samples3 <- rbind(k4_samples3, block)
}
k4_samples3 <- log2(k4_samples3 + SMOOTH)

pca <- prcomp(k4_samples3, center=T, scale.=T)

## Plot regions of interest

## Set color to be PC1 value on (-5,3)
pca1_level <- round(pca$x[,1])
pca1_level[pca1_level < -5] <- -5
rot_data <- data.frame(pca$x)
rot_data$col <- viridis(9)[pca1_level+6]
rot_data$col <- adjustcolor(rot_data$col, alpha.f = 0.2)

CATS <- c('enh.like.dist', 'prom.like.dist', 'prom.like.prom', 'enh.like.prom')
average_traj <- data.frame(matrix(nr=0,nc=3))
names(average_traj) <- c('PC1', 'PC2', 'PC3')

output_table <- data.frame()

pdf('output/k4me_timecourse_pca_groups.pdf', 5,8)
par(mfrow=c(4,3), pty='s')
for (CAT in CATS) {
	roi <- focus_regions[focus_regions[,5]==CAT,4]
	for (time in c('X1k', 'dome', 'shield')) {
		pts <- rot_data[paste0(roi, '_', time), ]
		plot(pts[,2], pts[,3], xlim=c(-4,4), ylim=c(-4,4), pch=19, bg=pts$col, col=pts$col, cex=0.5, main=paste0(CAT, time), xlab='PC2', ylab='PC3')
		abline(h=0)
		abline(v=0)

		data_for_output <- pts[,1:3]
		data_for_output$stage <- time
		data_for_output$group <- CAT
		output_table <- rbind(output_table, data_for_output)

		## Record average PC1, PC2, PC3
		average_traj[paste0(CAT, time),] <- c(mean(pts[,1]), mean(pts[,2]), mean(pts[,3]))	
	}
}
dev.off()

## Support panels: heatmap scale for PC1; average trajectories

pdf('output/k4me_timecourse_pca_colorscale.pdf', 6, 6)
plot(rep(0,9), 9:1, pch=21, col='gray', bg=viridis(9), cex=2, axes=F, xlab='', ylab='')
text(rep(0,9), 9:1, -5:3, pos=4) 
dev.off()

pdf('output/k4me_timecourse_pca_avg_biplot.pdf', 12,5)
par(mfrow=c(1,4), pty='s')
for (CAT in CATS) {
	plot(0,0,xlim=c(-1,2), ylim=c(-2,1), type='n', main = CAT, xlab='PC2', ylab='PC3')
	abline(h=0)
	abline(v=0)
	catpts <- average_traj[grepl(CAT, row.names(average_traj)), ]
	for (i in 1:3) {
		ptcol <- viridis(9)[round(catpts[i,1]) + 6]
		points(catpts[i,2], catpts[i,3], pch=19, col=ptcol)
		text(catpts[i,2], catpts[i,3], i, pos=2)
	}
}
dev.off()


#############
# 4. Summary data tables for paper supplement
#############

# Write out summary table for figure S3C

fig_s3c <- data_pca_rot_sub[,c('name', 'PC1', 'PC2', 'PC3', 'pch')]
fig_s3c$pch <- with(fig_s3c,
	ifelse(pch==16, 'k4me1_enh',
	ifelse(pch==15, 'k4me2_enh',
	ifelse(pch==18, 'highk4_prom',
	ifelse(pch==17, 'lowk4_prom', 'unlabeled')))))

fig_s3c <- fig_s3c[order(fig_s3c$pch), ]
fig_s3c[,2:4] <- round(fig_s3c[,2:4], 3)
names(fig_s3c)[5] <- 'group'

write.table(fig_s3c, 'output/fig_s3c_timecourse_pca.txt', row.names=F, col.names=T, sep='\t', quote=F)


# Write out summary table for figure S3D, S3E

fig_s3d <- output_table
fig_s3d$group <- with(fig_s3d,
	ifelse(group=='enh.like.dist', 'k4me1_enh',
	ifelse(group=='prom.like.dist', 'k4me2_enh',
	ifelse(group=='prom.like.prom', 'highk4_prom',
	ifelse(group=='enh.like.prom', 'lowk4_prom', NA)))))

fig_s3d[,1:3] <- round(fig_s3d[,1:3], 3)

write.table(fig_s3d, 'output/fig_s3d_k4_timecourse_pca.txt', row.names=T, col.names=T, sep='\t', quote=F)


fig_s3e <- round(average_traj, 3)

fig_s3e$stage <-
	ifelse(grepl('X1k', row.names(fig_s3e)), 'X1k',
	ifelse(grepl('dome', row.names(fig_s3e)), 'dome',
	ifelse(grepl('shield', row.names(fig_s3e)), 'shield', NA)))

fig_s3e$group <-
	ifelse(grepl('enh.like.dist', row.names(fig_s3e)), 'k4me1_enh',
	ifelse(grepl('prom.like.dist', row.names(fig_s3e)), 'k4me2_enh',
	ifelse(grepl('prom.like.prom', row.names(fig_s3e)), 'highk4_prom',
	ifelse(grepl('enh.like.prom', row.names(fig_s3e)), 'lowk4_prom', NA))))

write.table(fig_s3e, 'output/fig_s3e_k4_timecourse_pca_avg.txt', row.names=F, col.names=T, sep='\t', quote=F)
